# How to report your income to Centrelink

You can report your employment income in different ways.

Select your payment or service to find out how this impacts you:

### Raising kids

- [Parenting Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-to-report-your-income-to-centrelink?context=22196)

### Living arrangements

- [Farm Household Allowance](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-to-report-your-income-to-centrelink?context=22161)
- [Special Benefit](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-to-report-your-income-to-centrelink?context=22281)

### Ageing

- [Age Pension](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-to-report-your-income-to-centrelink?context=22526)

### Work

- [JobSeeker Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-to-report-your-income-to-centrelink?context=51411)
- [Youth Allowance for job seekers](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-to-report-your-income-to-centrelink?context=43921)

### Education

- [ABSTUDY Living Allowance](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-to-report-your-income-to-centrelink?context=45541)
- [Austudy](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-to-report-your-income-to-centrelink?context=22441)
- [Youth Allowance for students and Australian Apprentices](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-to-report-your-income-to-centrelink?context=43916)

### Health and disability

- [Carer Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-to-report-your-income-to-centrelink?context=21816)
- [Disability Support Pension](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-to-report-your-income-to-centrelink?context=22276)
